capture_scope.public_copy_note: Body length and source hash describe this redacted public record. Original citation position indexes are omitted; semantic judgments are retained.

coding_cautions: Do not infer the X platform from the placeholder X in example prompts; this answer does not substantively mention the X service.
Generic page-level GEO checkers are suggested without named products; do not invent tool identities from supporting publishers.
Citation/mention/recommendation modes are discussed, but no active-recommendation-rate formula or binary recommendation log column is provided.
Model versions, search-state logging and fresh-session controls are not explicitly specified in the workflow; preferring web-search modes is narrower.
Analytics capabilities and channel/report availability are captured as advice, not verified product specifications.
